issues.description: In problem_statement.md Part 1, the attribute list asks students to add fields named "inscribedStudents" and "guestStudents", but the UML diagram in the same statement (and the reference solution) use "numberOfInscribedStudents" and "numberOfGuestStudents". This can mislead students into creating fields/getters/setters with names that do not match the UML/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the Part 1 attribute list in problem_statement.md to match the UML/expected identifiers: use "numberOfInscribedStudents" and "numberOfGuestStudents" (and keep the naming consistent across the whole statement).
